request.prompt: Animate Daehan using the attached opening-clean reference image as the primary character reference. Keep his exact identity: silver-white long hair, violet eyes, black gat with a gold band and red tassels, plain black durumagi hanbok, white inner collar, and black gloves. COMPOSITION: Horizontal 16:9 widescreen. Daehan stays on the RIGHT THIRD of the frame for the entire clip, medium shot, eye level, not centered. WARDROBE AND SET: keep the robe, sleeves, collar, gloves, hat, tassels, balloon, and background completely plain with no writing or symbols. IMPORTANT: absolutely no text, no Korean characters, no calligraphy, no embroidery, no labels, no paper scroll, no subtitles, no caption bars, no logos, and no watermarks.
